notes.title: Hyper Gods v0.9 "Versus" is now live
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25857323/7e5bc5c9440c59d3b23a5c856bfcba800020fc39.png[/img]

The newest update for Hyper Gods, v0.9 "Versus", is now live. This new update brings to the game a new attack called Vector Raid and a new local multiplayer mode where players co-operate and compete to defeat the God.

Here are the full patch notes:
[list]
[*] Added Vector Raid to the game
[*] Added new Local Multiplayer mode
[*] Lock-On no longer requires Acceleration
[*] Tweaked God bullet speeds
[*] Improved the God's AI
[*] Changed the layout of the gameplay's UI
[*] Added new animations for the gameplay's UI
[*] Added new settings to the options menu
[*] Added new controller support
[*] Optimized several areas of the game
[*] Changed GCS logo animation
[*] Added epilepsy warning screen
[*] Fixed typos and UI inconsistencies
[*] Bug fixes
[/list]

We hope you enjoy the new additions to Hyper Gods!

notes.title: Update 0.9 release date + Vector Raid devlog
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25857323/7e5bc5c9440c59d3b23a5c856bfcba800020fc39.png[/img]

At long last, v0.9 of Hyper Gods will be deployed on April 10th. This update brings many new features to the game, one of them being the Vector Raid attack. This attack allows the Drifter to fend off incoming bullets and create openings in the God attacks, giving you new ways to turn the tides of battle.

To celebrate the arrival of Vector Raid, we've compiled a small devlog of the attack, giving you a little preview of its capabilities and how you can use it.

https://youtu.be/FZZssuULGtM

More surprises are coming soon. Thank you for your support.

notes.title: v0.8 "The Enlightenment" is now live
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25857323/e039f24cfb4e48716372292ef2bcdd4b14f9e05c.png[/img]

The Gods have changed, as v0.8 "The Enlightment" of Hyper Gods is now live. Featuring a complete overhaul of the Gods AI, new animations and attacks, along with support for Achievements, this update is yet another major one for the game.

Full patch notes below.

[b]Patch Notes[/b]
[list]
    [*]God AI overhaul
[list]
    [*]The God will now react to the player and their ability
    [*]The God will now react to its current state (HP, etc.)
    [*]Movement has been tweaked
    [*]Teleport distance has been reduced
    [*]The pacing of the attacks has been tweaked
    [*]Each attack now has its specific cooldown
    [*]The difficulty has been altered
[/list]
    [*]God animation overhaul
[list]
    [*]Added new movement animations
    [*]Added new attack animations
    [*]Added new teleport animations
    [*]Added new Hair animations
    [*]God will now stop moving when attacking
[/list] 
    [*]The Ship HUD has been tweaked 
[list]
    [*]It will now track the position of God
    [*]It will now only track bullets that are close by
[/list] 
    [*]Small other gameplay tweaks
    [*]Created a new MaxPhase Stat
    [*]Implement the first Steam Achievements
    [*]Added a new SFX when changing God Phase
    [*]Added new tips to the Loading Screen
[/list]

notes.title: v0.7 "The View" has arrived
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25857323/e039f24cfb4e48716372292ef2bcdd4b14f9e05c.png[/img]

The wrath of the Gods continues to rise as yet another update arrives on Hyper Gods. v.07 "The View" brings many improvements and new features to both the aesthetics and gameplay of the game, so pilots shall now definitely have a better experience fighting the Gods.

Full patch notes below. Thank you for your support.

[b]Patch Notes[/b]
[list]
    [*]Added post-processing effects: chromatic aberration, grain
    [*]Added new backgrounds
    [*]Added dynamic lights to the God's bullets
    [*]Gameplay tweaks: the turbo will no longer deplete on getting hit
    [*]Changed the Keyboard mapping to prevent Sticky Keys issues
    [*]Added a new attack for the God, codename: Protector
    [*]God AI tweaks
[list]
    [*]The Beam attack will kill in one hit now
    [*]Improved the accuracy of the Beam attack
    [*]Tweaked the teleport
[/list]
    [*]Added new Sound Effects
    [*]Added the newest version of the Menu Music
    [*]Added a Tutorial prompt for first time players
    [*]Added a highlight for the local player on the Leaderboards
    [*]Added a character limit for players with big usernames on the Leaderboards
    [*]Added an animation for when players scroll the Leaderboards
    [*]Optimized the size of the game executable
    [*]Fixed a major bug which prevented the controls from working properly on high-end PCs
    [*]Other bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Update v0.5.5 "The Challenge" is live!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25857323/e039f24cfb4e48716372292ef2bcdd4b14f9e05c.png[/img]

The time has arrived and update v0.5.5 "The Challenge" is now live. We believe that this update will provide a more enriching experience for all of you, offering a wide array of improvements to the game. The full patch notes for the update are below:
[list]
[*]	Added new sound to the game
    [list]
    [*]	New Music
    [*]	New and improved Sound Effects
    [/list]
[*]	Increased the Player HP
    [list]
    [*]	The player HP have been increased  from 2 to 4 
    [/list]
[*]	Tweaked the God’s AI
    [list]
    [*] Implemented basic movement
    [*]	Increased the firing rate
    [/list]
[*]	Redesigned the Player UI
    [list]
    [*]	Added a “multiplier progress” bar
    [*]	New design and animations for the UI
    [/list]
[*]	Implemented Stats
    [list]
    [*]	Gameplay Stats are now stored during the Fight
    [/list]
[*]	Implemented Leaderboards
    [list]
    [*]	The players’ best scores will automatically be stored in a Steam Leaderboard
    [/list]
[*]	Implement new Player Info
    [list]
    [*]	When in the menus, players can now check their Stats and Leaderboard position using a button prompt
    [/list]
[*]	Tweaked the camera transitions
    [list]
    [*]	Smoothed out the transition between the “close camera” and the “far camera”
    [*] Added new “far camera” indicators for both the Player and the God
    [/list]
[*]	Added a new Fight Entrance
    [list]
    [*] Each fight now has a new intro
    [*]	Created a “Ready-Engage” animation
    [/list]
[*]	Redesigned the Pause Menu
[*]	Redesigned the Post-Fight Menu
    [list]
    [*] Stats are now displayed when the Fight ends
    [/list]
[*]	Added new UI Icons to the Main and Options menus
[*]	Bug fixes
[/list]

Thank you again for your ongoing support.

The Gods are enraged.

notes.title: Hyper Gods Update released: Welcome Back (ver. 0.5.0)
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25857323/e039f24cfb4e48716372292ef2bcdd4b14f9e05c.png[/img]

And we’re live! As promised, we’ve just released the newest update for Hyper Gods, the Patch Notes of which are below. Remember that we temporarily blocked the multiplayer modes and fully implemented a Singleplayer mode.

We sincerely hope you enjoy this update. Happy shooting!

[h1]Hyper Gods ver. 0.5.0 Patch notes[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Changed the Match Flow/Rules
    [list]
        [*]Removed the casket destruction
        [*]Removed the tutorial
        [*]Now the match only ends when the player is destroyed
    [/list] 
    [*]Overhaul of the God NPC
    [list]
        [*]Adaptable AI
        [*]New movement behaviours
        [*]New charging behaviour
        [list]
            [*]The God recharges and increases its power level when his HP reaches 0
        [/list] 
        [*]New firing patterns
        [list]
            [*]New attacks introduced
            [*]Replaced the bullets graphics
        [/list] 
    [/list] 
    [*]Overhaul of the camera system
    [list]
        [*]Dynamic camera introduced
        [*]Camera now reacts to the player
        [*]Introduced new camera effects
    [/list]
    [*]Added the Matter
    [list]
        [*]Matter spawns when the God is hit
        [*]Matter increases the player’s score
        [*]Matter resets the player’s energy levels
    [/list]
    [*]Overhaul of the radar
    [list]
        [*]Radar now tracks the God’s bullets
        [*]Radar now tracks matter
        [*]Radar now indicates when the shield are down
    [/list]
    [*]Implemented full pre-match cutscene
    [list]
        [*]Players can now skip the cutscene
    [/list]
    [*]Minor tweaks
    [list]
        [*]Controls
        [*]Combo multiplier requirements
        [*]Bloom levels
        [*]Energy behaviour
        [list]
            [*]Energy now drains when using the turbo, not when firing
        [/list] 
    [/list]
    [*]New stage
    [list]
        [*]Removed the asteroids
    [/list]
    [*]Improved loading times
    [*]New UI animations
    [list]
        [*]Combo multiplier scaling
    [/list]
    [*]Added version number to the Start Menu
    [*]Changed the order of the Main Menu items
    [*]Added a retry button to the end of the Match
    [*]Blocked the access to the local multiplayer mode
    [*]Bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: New update release date and the future of Hyper Gods
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25857323/e039f24cfb4e48716372292ef2bcdd4b14f9e05c.png[/img]

First and foremost, as you might’ve seen from our [url=https://www.facebook.com/HyperGodz/]Facebook[/url] page, a new update is coming. Today, we can officially confirm that its release date is due right this week! This update is our biggest one yet, and contains many changes to the gameplay and feel of the game. The patch notes will further detail all the improvements that we've made. Below is a GIF of what you can expect in the patch. We sincerely hope you enjoy it.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/F31SydUvvjpQc/giphy.gif[/img]

Now, regarding the lack of recent news on Hyper Gods over the last few months, that is something directly related to this new update. As 2016 was ending, we analysed the state of the game and concluded that its quality was not in accordance with our standards and with what we wish to achieve. As such, we went back to the drawing board and redesigned many of the game mechanics which we thought were severely lacking. We all feel now that the soonly available iteration of Hyper Gods is miles better than the one currently available. Faster, more action packed and, above all else, fun.

To do this major overhaul of the game, we’ve also had to focus more and more on the Singleplayer components. So, in order to be able to bring you this update now, we’ve had to block the access to the local multiplayer modes, as they are still not yet ready for a public release. Nevertheless, this is a feature that will be coming back in a future update.

And speaking of the future, our plans are to come back to the more regular updates that we started this Early Access with. This first one will include, as soon as possible, a build with improvements to one of the components of the game that we’re still not happy with: the sound.

That’s it for this news update. Thank you for your patience.

Happy shooting!

notes.title: First Update is Live!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25857323/e039f24cfb4e48716372292ef2bcdd4b14f9e05c.png[/img]

Hello guys, it's time for the first Early Access update on Hyper Gods! As promised, this update brings you the first glimpse of the Singleplayer modes, with the inclusion of a Practice mode where you can get the handle on all the grazing and shooting before heading out to multiplayer. Along with it, we've got a bunch of new fixes and changes in this update, so be sure to check the Patch Notes down below.

Patch Notes:
[list]
    [*]Additions:
    [list]
         [*]New Singleplayer Practice Mode
    [/list]
    [*]Changes:
    [list]
         [*]Changed the animation of the game's intro logo
         [*]Changed the HUD display of the Goddess's HP
    [/list]
    [*]Fixes:
    [list]
         [*]Gameplay - Fixed a bug where the player could escape the game-area and wouldn't be able to come back
         [*]UI - Fixed a longer than expected transition back to the Main Menu
         [*]UI - Fixed a bug where the keyboard would incorrectly trigger the Versus match
    [/list]
[/list]

Regarding the next update, we are planning to launch it in two weeks' time with it consisting of several major improvements to the core gameplay. As for the Trello page, it is bound to be made live during the weekend!

With that, that's all for now. Be sure to leave your feedback here or in our [url=https://www.facebook.com/HyperGodz/]Facebook[/url] page. Happy shooting!
